caption: The drawing depicts a wooden chest of drawers with four visible legs, a flat rectangular top, and decorative front panels. The chest is colored in shades of brown, with the sides and top showing a wood grain texture. The front of the chest features ornate patterns in gold and black, displayed on multiple rectangular and square panels, including two narrow rows at the top and two larger sections below, presumably drawers. The patterns consist of symmetrical, repeating vine and leaf motifs. There are small, round knobs on the drawers for handles. The background is plain and light-colored, creating a contrast with the darker, detailed chest. The shadow cast on the surface beneath the chest is a muted greyish color.
title: Hadley Chest
